meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分诊问题与外部PR，生成可执行的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护开源项目，常被大量Issue和外部PR淹没，需要快速分诊归类。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an open-source project and need a fast way to sort incoming issues and external PRs.

howto.what: 当维护者把一个 issue 或 PR 交给它时，它会先读完整内容，判断这是故障还是新功能，并决定下一步该做什么（等待更多信息、交给 AI 或人工处理、不处理等）。它还会验证问题是否真实，必要时追问细节，最后在评论中给出结论。
howto.when: 当维护者输入“/triage”并用自然语言说明想处理的 issue 或 PR 时触发，例如“看看 #42”或“把 #42 改为 ready-for-agent”。

say.note: 它会读取内容并提出分类建议。
它会直接应用状态变更。

say.text: 有哪些 issue 等着处理？
say.note: 它会列出需要关注的 issue 列表。

howto.what_en: When the maintainer hands it an issue or PR, it reads all content, decides if it's a bug or enhancement, and sets the next state (needs-info, ready, wontfix, etc). It verifies the claim, asks follow-ups if needed, and posts a comment with the outcome.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the maintainer types “/triage” and describes the target issue or PR, e.g. “look at #42” or “move #42 to ready-for-agent”.

say_en.note: It will read and suggest a classification.
It applies the state change directly.
It lists the items that need triage.
